title: SBack
description: This minecraft paper/spigot lets players go back to their death location by just clicking a message or by typing /back, its a simple lightweight plugin
body:
**SBack**

Simple. Fast. Fair death recovery.

SBack is a lightweight Paper plugin that allows players to return to their most recent death location by clicking a message or by typing /back. It keeps things convenient while still maintaining balance on survival servers.

When a player dies and respawns, they automatically receive a clickable message to return to where they fell. They can either click the message or type /back manually.

To keep gameplay fair, SBack includes a built-in 5 minute timer. After five minutes, the saved death location expires and can no longer be used.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

 _**(1) 🔁 How It Works**_

☠ When a player dies
-  Their death location is saved automatically.
-  After respawning, they receive a clickable /back message.

**(i)⌛ When /back is used**
-  A 5 second countdown begins.
-  An action bar shows the remaining time.
-  The player must not move during the countdown.
-  If they move, the teleport is cancelled.
-  If the countdown finishes, they are teleported to their death location.

**(ii)⏳ After 5 minutes**
-  The saved death location expires.
-  /back will no longer work for that death.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

_**(2)✨ Features**_

-  Clickable respawn message
-  Simple /back command
-  5 second teleport countdown
-  Movement cancels teleport
-  5 minute expiry timer
-  Lightweight and optimized
-  Built for modern Paper versions

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

_**(3)🎯 Perfect For**_

-  Survival SMP servers
-  Balanced hardcore gameplay
-  Servers that want convenience without removing consequences

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

SBack keeps everything clean and straightforward. No unnecessary complexity. Just a fair and reliable way for players to return to where they fell.
